settings.heading: We built the NMN we couldn't find.
settings.subtext: AEON started with a frustrating discovery: most NMN on the market is underdosed, untested, or cut with fillers — and almost none of it shows its work. So we set a higher bar and refused to move it.

settings.title: Clinically meaningful
settings.text: 1000 mg per serving — not the 125–250 mg that lets others hit a price point.

settings.title: Tested & published
settings.text: Independent COA for every lot. If we can't show it, we don't claim it.

settings.title: Nothing you don't need
settings.text: Just NMN and a vegetable capsule. No fillers, flow agents or marketing dust.

settings.heading: From raw material to your door.
settings.content:
We source pharmaceutical-grade β-NMN and verify identity and purity before anything is encapsulated. Manufacturing happens in a cGMP-certified facility. Then every finished lot goes back out to an ISO 17025-accredited lab — a separate set of eyes — to confirm what's on the label is what's in the bottle.

Heavy metals, microbials, residual solvents, assay purity: all checked, all documented. The QR code on your bottle pulls up that exact lot's certificate. No "proprietary blend" hand-waving, no trust-me-bro.

Why it matters

  • NMN is fragile and easy to adulterate — testing is the only real safeguard.
  • Underdosing is the industry's quiet default; the full dose is the whole point.
  • Transparency should be the floor, not a premium feature.

That's the entire company, really: do the boring, expensive things right, and show our work.

settings.heading: Held to your standard, too.
settings.text: Try it for 60 nights. If AEON isn't everything we say, we refund you — and you keep the bottle.
